entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return these cycling shoes I bought. This is completely unacceptable!
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can definitely look into that for you. To start, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
A preference? No! They're defective! They're giving me horrible blisters on every ride. I've tried adjusting the cleats a dozen times, nothing works. For the price I paid, this is just robbery.

I certainly understand your frustration; getting blisters is the last thing you want when you're trying to enjoy a ride. Let me just pull up your order. I see you received them 32 days ago. Is that correct?

I don't know, maybe! It's been a month of me trying to make them work. I'm done. I want a refund, and if I don't get it, I'm lighting you up on every review site there is. Get me your manager right now!
That won't be necessary, sir. I can help you directly. I've just checked our policy, and you are well within the 90-day return window for a full refund.
Wait, really? So you're just going to process it? No hassle?

That's correct. I've already initiated the return authorization for you. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file. Just package the cycling shoes back in their box, attach the label, and drop them off. Once we receive them, your refund will be processed.
Oh. Okay. Well, that's what I wanted. Thank you.
You're very welcome. I'm glad I could resolve this for you. Will there be anything else today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a better rest of your day.
